title: Case 018: Two Future Payments
initial_request: I can see two future payments of £34.80 to Northmere Heating. Please check whether they are duplicates and remove the duplicate.
overview: Mara Ellison contacted H&V after the secure portal showed two future payment lines to the same payee. The agent checked H&V's instruction journal and confirmed the entries arose from separate instructions: a standing order and a direct debit mandate. Neither was cancelled because the customer had not specified which instruction to change.

next_action.summary: Check the types and internal references of both instructions in H&V's journal before considering any change.

outcome: H&V confirmed that the two future entries have separate instruction records: one standing order and one direct debit mandate. Neither was cancelled; the customer must identify which instruction, if any, they want changed.

events.body: Two future payment lines of £34.80 to Northmere Heating are shown. Their relationship has not been established.
After completing H&V's identity checks, I asked you to escalate this and remove the duplicate. I do not know which line is the duplicate.
I am checking the type and internal reference of each instruction behind the two future lines. I have not cancelled either instruction.
The entries match separate instruction records: one customer standing order and one direct debit mandate. Their types and internal references are distinct.

I have confirmed that these are two separate instructions: a standing order and a direct debit mandate for the same payee. I have not cancelled either; if you want a change, please identify which instruction so we can confirm your request before acting.
